Nom Bot 2.0 · AI

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Here are the main options, in simple terms:

Meal plan details: You choose recipes, portion size (full or half), and how many meal packs per day.
Recipe setup: Pick one or more recipes, then choose Fixed (same recipes every order) or Rotate (switch recipes each delivery).
Portion & feeding info: Your dog’s exact portions and feeding guide are shown on the Pets page in your account.
Activity level: Set your dog as Average, Active, or Athlete so we can size portions correctly.
Delivery & billing: Orders auto-ship on a schedule; you can change when/where meals arrive and see order history in your account.
Extras: You can add treats and probiotics as a one-time add-on or in every box.
Picky eater tips: Warm meals a bit or use multiple recipes (Fixed or Rotate) to keep things interesting.
Trial & subscription: You start with a two-week trial, then it continues as a recurring subscription every four weeks, which you can adjust or cancel anytime before the order deadline.

All of these are managed from your online Nom Nom account.
